name: Object Field
thesis: Raygen's machines, avatar, and Hack Club world become a tangible installation arranged across a dark spatial field.
interaction: Choose any object to lift it into focus and reveal its story; take SERV0's panels away with a working Look inside control.
why: The actual printers and personal artwork carry the identity, with an asymmetric composition that feels like stepping into a maker's head rather than browsing a portfolio grid.
